BillHeading.BriefDescription: Preventing water-sewer districts from prohibiting multipurpose fire sprinkler systems.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to preventing water-sewer districts from prohibiting multipurpose fire sprinkler systems; and adding a new section to chapter 57.02 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 57.02 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: A water-sewer district may not prohibit the use of multipurpose fire sprinkler systems that are part of a structure's plumbing system for single-family homes and town houses as defined by the state residential building code or require a separate water meter or backflow preventer for the multipurpose fire sprinkler system.
